title: Late Charges Already Booked and the Rate on a Reinstated Schedule
content:
Late charges already booked add to the late charge rate on a deduction schedule a returned remittance reinstated, under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: where at least 2 late charges were booked on the agreement on entry dates from which fewer than 12 whole months have passed to today, 0.5 percentage points are added; where exactly 1 was, 0.25 percentage points are added; otherwise none. A whole month from an entry date is reached on the same day of the month as that entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day, and every late charge on the agreement counts, whatever item it charged.

| Late charges booked in the window | Points added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.5 |
| exactly 1 | 0.25 |
| none | none |

**When the charge is fixed.** A late charge on a deduction schedule reinstated by a returned remittance is fixed only after, where the employer-liable shortfall notice booked most recently is the only employer-liable notice booked that day and the only one on the deduction schedule it concerns, that schedule carries no remittance return, and the notice has an open amount of at least the de minimis amount, that notice carries the late charge owed for the late-charge period it is in once its late-charge grace has passed. The de minimis amount is 25.00 US dollars. Read against the records: while such a notice, open by at least 25.00 US dollars, is past its late-charge grace and does not yet carry the late charge owed for the late-charge period it is in, the late charge on the reinstated schedule is not fixed.
